name: Ecovacs
description: ECOVACS GOAT robot mowers and DEEBOT robot vacuums, through the ECOVACS HOME account they are bound to - the way the app reaches them. Connect the account once and each robot on it is added on its own: a mower with its job, its battery and every setting the app has; a vacuum with its rooms, a live map, its suction, water and consumables. Needs the internet: neither has a local API.
